from z3 import *

# Boolean variables representing C conditions/variables
gencrl = Bool('gencrl')
crl_ext = Bool('crl_ext')            # represents (crl_ext != NULL)
crlnumberfile = Bool('crlnumberfile')  # represents (crlnumberfile != NULL)
crlnumber = Bool('crlnumber')        # represents (crlnumber != NULL) after load_serial
tmpser = Bool('tmpser')              # represents (tmpser != NULL)
BN_add_word_ok = Bool('BN_add_word_ok')  # represents !BN_add_word(crlnumber, 1) == 0 (success)
save_serial_ok = Bool('save_serial_ok')  # represents !save_serial(...) == 0 (success)
rotate_serial_ok = Bool('rotate_serial_ok')  # represents !rotate_serial(...) == 0 (success)

s = Solver()

# Constraint 1: !(gencrl) || !(crl_ext != NULL || crlnumberfile != NULL) || !(crlnumberfile != NULL) || !(!BN_add_word(crlnumber, 1))
# Included because it references crlnumberfile and crlnumber (the target variable).

         Not(Or(crl_ext, crlnumberfile)),
         Not(crlnumberfile),
         BN_add_word_ok))

# Constraint 2: !(gencrl) || !(crl_ext != NULL || crlnumberfile != NULL) || !(crlnumberfile != NULL) || !(!tmpser)
# Included because it references crlnumberfile (target condition).
# C: !gencrl || !(crl_ext || crlnumberfile) || !crlnumberfile || tmpser

         Not(Or(crl_ext, crlnumberfile)),
         Not(crlnumberfile),
         tmpser))

# Constraint 3: !(gencrl) || !(crlnumberfile != NULL) || !((crlnumber = load_serial(crlnumberfile, NULL, 0, NULL)) == NULL)
# Included because it directly constrains crlnumberfile and crlnumber.
# C: !gencrl || !crlnumberfile || (crlnumber != NULL)  [load_serial succeeded]
s.add(Or(Not(gencrl),
         Not(crlnumberfile),
         crlnumber))

# Constraint 4: !(gencrl) || !(crl_ext != NULL || crlnumberfile != NULL) || !(crlnumberfile != NULL) || !(!save_serial(crlnumberfile, "new", crlnumber, NULL))
# Included because it references crlnumberfile and crlnumber.
# C: !gencrl || !(crl_ext || crlnumberfile) || !crlnumberfile || save_serial_ok
s.add(Or(Not(gencrl),
         Not(Or(crl_ext, crlnumberfile)),
         Not(crlnumberfile),
         save_serial_ok))

# Constraint 5: !(gencrl) || !(crlnumberfile != NULL) || !(!rotate_serial(crlnumberfile, "new", "old"))
# Included because it references crlnumberfile (target condition).
# C: !gencrl || !crlnumberfile || rotate_serial_ok
s.add(Or(Not(gencrl),
         Not(crlnumberfile),
         rotate_serial_ok))

# Relevant condition from line 982: if (crlnumberfile != NULL)
# Modeled as an implication guard: when crlnumberfile is true, the guarded block executes.

print(s.check())
